claude.hintUncached: Input tokens billed at full rate - cache reads and cache writes are counted in their own columns.
claude.consoleEmptyTitle: No Console usage in this range
claude.consoleEmpty: Your Anthropic Console key works, but nothing was billed through Console in {range}. Claude Code running on a Pro or Max subscription is not billed through Console, so it never appears in this report - the figures below come from this machine's transcripts instead.
claude.webNoPlanTitle: Plan limits stay on this computer
claude.webNoPlan: The 5-hour and weekly meters come from the Claude Code login in ~/.claude. A browser cannot read that. An Admin API key, entered in the sign-in form, is what this page can show.
claude.webNoTranscriptsTitle: Local transcripts stay on this computer
claude.webNoTranscripts: Claude Code writes its transcripts under ~/.claude on the machine where it runs. This page cannot see them. Console usage above is the billed report, when an Admin API key is connected.
